channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: A Debris Apron in Phlegra Montes
item.description: Phlegra Montes has many lobate debris aprons, but are these here are understudied compared to others on Mars. With this image, we can examine the shape of the apron surface and the source region to understand their evolution and whether ice-rich flow has been involved. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
